in_hebrew.name: הרצוג
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word רצה (ratsah), meaning 'to rule', this name could be translated as 'ruler', 'leader', or 'duke'.

in_greek.name: Ἡρσοδικης
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word ἥρσος (hersos), meaning 'ruler' or 'lord', this name is derived from the root ἥρα (hēra), which means 'ruler' or 'lord'. The suffix -δικης (-dikēs) is added to indicate a 'ruler' or 'duke'.

in_latin.name: Herzogius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'herzog', derived from the German 'Herzog', meaning 'duke' or 'ruler'. This name has been adopted into Latin to denote someone of high rank and authority.
